build_nccl_engine: build an NCCL weight transfer engine to broadcast model weights from a trainer to vLLM inference workers
init_nccl_process_group: initialize an NCCL process group for weight transfer using a stateless process group and PyNcclCommunicator
receive_model_weights: receive model weights from a trainer via NCCL broadcast and load them incrementally into a model
send_model_weights: send model weights from a trainer to vLLM workers using packed or simple NCCL broadcasting
create_nccl_trainer_group: create an NCCL trainer-side process group for weight transfer with master address, port, and world size
